parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a $photon$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: A stationary cobalt-60 ($^{60}_{27}\text{Co}$) nucleus emits a $\gamma$-ray photon of energy $1.18\text{ MeV}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the wavelength of the photon.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the momentum of the photon is $6.3 \times 10^{-22}\text{ N s}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use information in (b)(ii) to determine the recoil speed of the cobalt-60 nucleus when the $\gamma$-ray photon is emitted.
